A Note to Parents & Learners

"Why I Started NPconscious"

Throughout school and college, I observed brilliant students lose their spark simply because mathematics was presented as an unforgiving gauntlet of rules and timed drills. The beauty of reasoning was lost under the weight of memorization.

After working across top tech and education organizations like Bhanzu, Airbnb, and Concentrix, I realized that true learning happens when a student feels emotionally safe to say: "I don’t understand this yet — can we look at it another way?"

That is why NPconscious was born in January 2026. Here, we celebrate the questions as much as the answers. We want our students to walk out of every session with their eyes wide open, excited to look at the world mathematically.

Nikhil Parag

Founder & Academic Director, NPconscious
